Name: Guro Cows
Author: lonelyluster
Description:
[size=3]Happy cows in pastel colors, with pastel blood, with their heads and leg chopped off[/size]

[b]Warning, guro is extreme gore that doesn't show pain or horror, but there's still blood (although it's bright colors and also pixelated so)[/b]

[size=2]Comes in four colors, two for each type of cow (brown and white).[/size]

[i]To download, make a backup of your White Cow.xnb/Brown Cow.xnb (Stardew Valley>Content>Animals) then place your choice of color in the Animals tab, and erase the -color so it only reads as above.[/i]
